children: said on Monday that Chief Financial Officer Jessica Fischer would step down on October 15 and named Kevin Howard interim CFO.
The company, shares of which were down over 2% in extended trading, said it would immediately launch a search for a finance chief.
Howard, currently Charter's executive vice president and chief accounting officer and controller, previously served as interim CFO in 2010.
The departure comes while Charter contends with steeper-than-expected losses in its broadband customer base, as traditional cable internet faces stiff competition from telecom rivals.
Fischer, who joined Charter nearly a decade ago and became CFO in 2021, will relocate for another professional opportunity, the company said in a statement.
